# Zohaib DigiForge — Digital Resources & Creative Studio

> Empowering Learning, Powering Success. Premium courses, developer software, design assets, e-books, and educational tools for students, creators, and businesses worldwide.

## Overview
- Website: https://www.zohaibdigiforge.store
- Flat Price Store: Rs. 279 / $1 for premium curated digital resources.
- Payments Supported: JazzCash, EasyPaisa, SadaPay, Nayapay, Pakistani Bank Transfers (Raast), and USDT/Crypto (Binance Pay).
- Instant Fulfillment: Instant Google Drive download link & license activation key delivery after checkout.
- Support: 24/7 WhatsApp & Email verification (+92 340 6070632, zohaibdigiforge@gmail.com).

## Digital Resource Categories
1. **Online Courses & Masterclasses**: Complete full-stack development, cybersecurity, AI & prompting, digital marketing, and video editing suites.
2. **Pro Software & Utilities**: Developer toolkits, productivity suites, and workflow extensions.
3. **Templates & UI Kits**: Figma design systems, Framer landing page kits, Notion workspaces, and pitch decks.
4. **Graphics & Video Assets**: LUTs, overlays, motion graphic templates, stock vectors, and 3D icon sets.
5. **E-Books & Guides**: Business scaling, AI prompts, tech blueprints, and programming roadmaps.
6. **Pro Tools Subscriptions**: Canva Pro Lifetime, ChatGPT Plus GPT-4o, CapCut Pro Lifetime, Google Gemini Pro 1.5.
